item.title: Claude Duet, PHP Flaws and OpenAI on Google
item.description: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent that works autonomously while you're away, in preview for US Pro/Max users. AI models (GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini) found two critical PHP flaws letting hackers hijack servers without login; patches are now live. OpenAI's models and Codex agent tool are coming to Google Cloud's Model Garden, plus Google's Antigravity and Gemini Agent soon.

item.title: DeepSeek's free engine, scorpion proteins, OpenAI buys
item.description: DeepSeek open-sourced DeepInfer, the engine behind its production AI service, free for anyone to deploy. Anthropic's Claude autonomously designed 318,000 scorpion-antivenom candidate proteins; 17 bound their target in lab tests. OpenAI acquired drug-trial startup Orchestra Bio, while Altman told staff AI's endgame may need a global regulator.

item.title: Cheap AI, Fast Models, and a $50 Break-In
item.description: Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion model claims speed and quality edge over GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5. MiniMax's M3.1 Flash cuts agent costs 70% and triples inference speed versus its predecessor. US DHS ordered agencies to purge DeepSeek, while hackers used AI agents to breach 100+ companies.

item.title: Anthropic's $48B pledge, DeepSeek's price cut
item.description: Anthropic commits 5% equity (about $48B) to a new Public Benefit Fund for workers hit by AI. DeepSeek's cheaper open-weight model and new web-search APIs undercut US rivals on price and speed. OpenAI's mystery 'Aurora' image models and a new Chrome computer-use feature surfaced over the weekend.
